My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
I should have been glad to accept your ‘Manchester Visit’, but it has been forestalled as you will [see](/periodical/52) on the first of August.
I have put out [your princesses](/place/262) for October but I do not feel sure how the space will be[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Anne Smith/ Stepney Rectory/ London and postmarked Winchester 29 July and on reverse 30 July 1857.
[^2]: ‘A Glimpse into a Royal Home Seventy Years Ago’ MP 14 (November 1857) 470-96.
